# Orbweaver

Orbweaver is a local-first workspace for character-driven AI conversations, world knowledge, presets,
analysis, and role-playing state.

## Agent operation

- [Open Orbweaver](/)
- [Read the development agent-tool guide](https://github.com/Inktomi93/orbweaver/blob/main/packages/client/src/lib/agent-tools.README.md)

The signed-in application is a stateful single-page interface. In a development build, wait for
`html[data-app-ready]`, inspect `window.__orb.snap()`, discover valid targets with
`window.__orb.nav.capabilities()`, and navigate through `window.__orb.nav` instead of guessing click
chains. Use the page accessibility tree for rendered state and the `pnpm snap` selector map for exact,
executable targets.
